config_manifest_excerpt_verbatim.mechanism_statement: An opening gap beyond the 50th percentile of the trailing 252-bar SIGNED-gap distribution over-extends (CONFIRM mechanism)
config_manifest_excerpt_verbatim.r4_trend_only_book: conditioning variable alone: the SIGNED gap traded without threshold or fade direction — g[i+1] > 0 -> LONG; g[i+1] < 0 -> SHORT (up-gap -> LONG, down-gap -> SHORT, no percentile trigger)
config_manifest_excerpt_verbatim.sign_frozen: MEDIAN split: fires when g[i+1] crosses the median in either direction; direction: up-gap -> LONG; down-gap -> SHORT (gap information persists through the session)
config_manifest_excerpt_verbatim.state_formula: gap g[i] = O[i] - C[i-1], SIGNED; trigger level q = SIGNED quantile at 50/100 (linear interpolation) of the trailing 252-gap window ending at and including g[i]; side selection PIN (P0 pin #1): the percentile ITSELF selects the side — p < 50 is a DOWN-tail level (state fires when g[i+1] <= q); p > 50 is an UP-tail level (fires when g[i+1] >= q); p = 50 is the MEDIAN split (fires when g[i+1] crosses the median in either direction; g[i+1] == median does not fire). Timing exception (§4 F3): state formed from close(t) and open(t+1), knowable exactly at bar t+1's open; the forced fill AT that same open(t+1) is the ONE declared exception to the no-same-bar-signal-fill rule (the fill price IS the first bookable price — no look-ahead); exit mapping: any exit condition knowable at a bar close executes at the next bar's open; state NOT FIRED when the 252-gap window is incomplete or no execution bar t+1 exists in the same fold (fail-closed)
